### OPEN FILES AND DISPLAY DATA

```{r}
library(readxl)
PropPass <- read_excel("PropPass_Stats.xlsx")
names(PropPass)
#View(PropPass)

```

```{r}

PropPass$Cell -> Cell
PropPass$Level -> Level

PropPass$Rs -> Rs
PropPass$Rm -> Rm
PropPass$Cm -> Cm
PropPass$Tau ->Tau

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
PropPass$Level <- factor(PropPass$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))

```

### A) Acces Resistance (Rs)

#### 1-SUMMARIZE Rs by Region

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Rs~Level,
       PropPass,
        digits = 1)

```

#### 2-PLOT DATA for Rs

```{r}

Bx_Rs <- ggplot(PropPass, aes(x=Level,y=Rs, color=Level)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_Rs + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_ProPass", filename = "Bx_Rs.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)


Pt_Rs<-ggplot(PropPass, aes(x=Level,y=Rs, color=Level)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_Rs + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_ProPass", filename = "Pt_Rs.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
```

#### 3-STATISTICAL analysis - Rs

#### Kruskal Wallis test - Rs

```{r}
kruskal.test(Rs ~ Level, data = PropPass)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Rs, Level,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Rs ~ Level,
                    data   = PropPass,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

### G) Firing pattern across Levels

#### 1-Open file Firing Pattern

```{r}
library(readxl)
FP <- read_excel("Firing_Pattern.xlsx")
names(FP)
#View(FP)

FP$Level -> Level
FP$Fire -> Fire
FP$Perc -> Perc

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
FP$Level <- factor(FP$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
FP$Fire <- factor(FP$Fire, levels = c("Tonic", "Phasic"))

```

#### 2-SUMMARIZE Firing Pattern by Region

```{r}
print(FP)

```

#### 3-STATISTICAL analysis - Firing Pattern

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)

# Merge it with the FP data
total_counts <- data.frame(Level = unique(FP$Level), Total = 100)  # Replace with actual counts
FP <- left_join(FP, total_counts, by = "Level")

# Reshape data into a contingency table
table_data <- FP %>%
  select(Level, Fire, Perc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Fire, values_from = Perc, values_fill = list(Perc = 0))

# Convert dataframe to matrix
matrix_data <- as.matrix(table_data[, -1])  # Remove first column (Level)
rownames(matrix_data) <- table_data$Level  # Assign row names

# Perform Fisher’s Exact Test
fisher_result <- fisher.test(matrix_data)

# Print results
print(matrix_data)
print(fisher_result)

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)

# Define all possible pairs of regions
region_pairs <- combn(unique(FP$Level), 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Number of comparisons for Bonferroni correction
num_comparisons <- length(region_pairs)
alpha <- 0.05  # Standard significance level
alpha_adjusted <- alpha / num_comparisons  # Bonferroni correction

# Loop through each pair and perform Fisher’s Exact Test
pairwise_results <- lapply(region_pairs, function(pair) {
  # Filter data for the current pair of regions
  sub_data <- FP %>% filter(Level %in% pair)
  
  # Reshape into a contingency table
  table_data <- sub_data %>%
    select(Level, Fire, Perc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Fire, values_from = Perc, values_fill = list(Count = 0))
  
  # Convert to matrix format
  matrix_data <- as.matrix(table_data[, -1])  # Remove Level column
  rownames(matrix_data) <- table_data$Level  # Assign row names
  
  # Perform Fisher’s Exact Test
  test_result <- fisher.test(matrix_data)
  
  # Store results in a list
  list(
    Pair = paste(pair, collapse = " vs. "),
    Matrix = matrix_data,
    P_Value = test_result$p.value,
    Significant = test_result$p.value < alpha_adjusted,  # Adjusted significance check
    Adjusted_Alpha = alpha_adjusted,
    Result = test_result
  )
})

# Print results
for (res in pairwise_results) {
  cat("\n\n🔹 Comparison:", res$Pair, "\n")
  print(res$Matrix)
  cat("P-value:", res$P_Value, "\n")
  cat("Bonferroni-adjusted threshold:", res$Adjusted_Alpha, "\n")
  cat("Significant after Bonferroni correction?", ifelse(res$Significant, "✅ YES", "❌ NO"), "\n")
}


```

### H) Firing pattern across Levels and Localisation

#### 1-Open file Firing Pattern per Level and Localisation

```{r}
library(readxl)
FPL <- read_excel("Firing_pattern_Loc.xlsx")
names(FPL)
#View(FPL)


FPL$Level -> Level
FPL$Loc -> Loc
FPL$Fire -> Fire
FPL$Perc -> Perc

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping

FPL$Level <- factor(FPL$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
FPL$Loc <- factor(FPL$Loc, levels = c("Dorsal", "Lateral","Ventral"))
FPL$Fire <- factor(FPL$Fire, levels = c("Tonic", "Phasic"))

```

#### 2-SUMMARIZE Firing Pattern by Region

```{r}
print(FPL)

```

#### 3-STATISTICAL analysis - Firing Pattern

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)

# Merge it with the FP data
total_counts <- data.frame(Loc = unique(FPL$Loc), Total = 100)  # Replace with actual counts
FPL <- left_join(FPL, total_counts, by = "Loc")

# Reshape data into a contingency table
table_data <- FPL %>%
  select(Loc, Fire, Perc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Fire, values_from = Perc)

# Convert dataframe to matrix
matrix_data <- as.matrix(table_data[, -1])  # Remove first column (Level)
rownames(matrix_data) <- table_data$Level  # Assign row names

# Perform Fisher’s Exact Test
fisher_result <- fisher.test(matrix_data)

# Print results
print(matrix_data)
print(fisher_result)

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)

# Define all possible pairs of regions
region_pairs <- combn(unique(FP$Level), 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Number of comparisons for Bonferroni correction
num_comparisons <- length(region_pairs)
alpha <- 0.05  # Standard significance level
alpha_adjusted <- alpha / num_comparisons  # Bonferroni correction

# Loop through each pair and perform Fisher’s Exact Test
pairwise_results <- lapply(region_pairs, function(pair) {
  # Filter data for the current pair of regions
  sub_data <- FPL %>% filter(Level %in% pair)
  
  # Reshape into a contingency table
  table_data <- sub_data %>%
    select(Level, Fire, Perc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Fire, values_from = Perc, values_fill = list(Count = 0))
  
  # Convert to matrix format
  matrix_data <- as.matrix(table_data[, -1])  # Remove Level column
  rownames(matrix_data) <- table_data$Level  # Assign row names
  
  # Perform Fisher’s Exact Test
  test_result <- fisher.test(matrix_data)
  
  # Store results in a list
  list(
    Pair = paste(pair, collapse = " vs. "),
    Matrix = matrix_data,
    P_Value = test_result$p.value,
    Significant = test_result$p.value < alpha_adjusted,  # Adjusted significance check
    Adjusted_Alpha = alpha_adjusted,
    Result = test_result
  )
})

# Print results
for (res in pairwise_results) {
  cat("\n\n🔹 Comparison:", res$Pair, "\n")
  print(res$Matrix)
  cat("P-value:", res$P_Value, "\n")
  cat("Bonferroni-adjusted threshold:", res$Adjusted_Alpha, "\n")
  cat("Significant after Bonferroni correction?", ifelse(res$Significant, "✅ YES", "❌ NO"), "\n")
}
```
